notes: Optional manual peer hints merged with overlap groups and substitution rules in sourceOverlapLookupEngine.

firewalls.notes: Perimeter controls often share flow, threat, and VPN telemetry with adjacent security layers.

ids_ips.notes: Inline or TAP IDS may duplicate firewall UTM or NDR behavioral alerts.

ndr.notes: NDR sensors may ingest the same flows as firewall exports or NetFlow collectors.

proxy.notes: Web proxy, SWG, and SASE often consolidate into one SSE platform.

sase.notes: SASE bundles SWG, ZTNA, CASB, and sometimes firewall functions.

vpn.notes: VPN concentrators may run on firewalls or be replaced by SASE ZTNA.

edr.notes: EDR agents often stream the same host events collected by OS log forwarders.

windows_servers.notes: WinEvent Security channels overlap with EDR and domain-controller telemetry.

active_directory.notes: Directory Service events may duplicate IdP sign-in and PAM audit streams.

saas_office.notes: M365 audit volume may be double-counted in general SaaS or CASB rows.

saas_general.notes: Blended SaaS totals often include productivity and IdP audit already sized elsewhere.

casb.notes: CASB may share cloud app governance telemetry with SSE and posture tools.

cspm.notes: Posture findings vs. raw control-plane logs vs. runtime workload telemetry.

cwpp.notes: Workload protection and posture from one vendor can emit overlapping findings.

iaas.notes: Control-plane audit logs overlap with CSPM misconfiguration alerts on the same accounts.
